title: The Very First Website Ever Made Is Still Online

scenes.text: The first website ever made is still online.
Tim Berners-Lee built it at CERN in 1991.
It simply explained what the web was and how to make a page.
CERN restored it in 2013, at its original address.
You can open it right now on your phone.
The first page of the entire web is one click away.
